question: In which month, Women's Reservation Bill 2023 [The Constitution (One Hundred Twenty-Eighth Amendment) Bill, 2023] was introduced in Lok Sabha in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**September**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Women's Reservation Bill 2023 [The Constitution (One Hundred Twenty-Eighth Amendment) Bill, 2023] w**as introduced in the Lok Sabha in September 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• The Women's Reservation Bill 2023, formally known as **The Constitution (One Hundred Twenty-Eighth Amendment) Bill, 2023**,
 
• It was introduced in the Lok Sabha on **19th September 2023**.
 
• The **bill had been in discussion for many years, b**ut it was reintroduced and passed in September 2023 during a special session of Parliament.
 
• **However, the implementation of this reservation will only take place after a nationwide census and**
 
 
• **delimitation exercise, which is expected after the next general elections.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** About** **Women's reservation bill**

 
 
• It aims to provide 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies, to improve the representation of women in politics and decision-making processes.
 
• The idea of women's reservation had been debated for decades, with earlier versions of the bill introduced in Parliament in 1996, 1998, and 2008, but none were enacted
